# GitHub Template Repository Badges

Use these badges in your README.md to highlight that this is a template repository:

## Template Badge

```markdown
[![Template Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/Template-Repository-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/bthos/robot-automation-blueprint/generate)
```

Preview:
[![Template Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/Template-Repository-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/bthos/robot-automation-blueprint/generate)

## Notes

- The `../../generate` link is a relative path that works from within the repository
- Replace with full URL `https://github.com/YOUR_ORG/REPO_NAME/generate` if needed
- The badges are already implemented in the main README.md file
